carefree.line: Now you're a hotshot, think you're so carefree
stanza: Downtown hotspot halfway through this life
I used to feel free, or was it just a dream?
Now you're a hotshot, think you're so carefree
But you're just seventeen, so much like me
You're just seventeen, you're just seventeen

carefree.line: Now if I appear to be carefree
stanza: Now if I appear to be carefree
It's only to camouflage my sadness
In order to shield my pride I try
To cover the hurt with a show of gladness
